source.note: Latents are recorded for reproducibility and never passed to predictors.

diagnostics.note: Classic split Rhat and conservative batch/between-chain MCSE are diagnostics, not a convergence certificate; exponent and row quadrature error are separate.

source.control: one repeated label; exact observed-rank reduction

diagnostics.note: Classic split Rhat and conservative batch/between-chain MCSE are diagnostics, not a convergence certificate; exponent and row quadrature error are separate.

exact.explanation: The unseen-label probability follows exact exchangeability and total probability; independent raw row-normalization checks are reported separately.

refined.explanation: The unseen-label probability follows exact exchangeability and total probability; independent raw row-normalization checks are reported separately.

limitations: Two fixed numerical controls, not a representative source ensemble.
MCMC diagnostic thresholds are reported separately from exact-reference accuracy checks.
Shared backend tables are read only; the two row evaluators are not independent of their shared phi backend.
Row-grid checks cover specified latent states only.
Exponent quadrature refinement covers these prefixes only.
No transformer predictions or cumulative sequential codelengths are evaluated.
